Englot admits to trying dating 

Englot goes to the US

June 2023

Englot is very lovey dovey and bring that same energy back to Thailand 

The girls are openly flirting, openly clingy, open about liking each other and having feelings things are on cloud 9

July 2023

Things start to get shakey. 🐢 (N) isn’t happy with EL relationship being real. Even said imagination couples are easier to handle than real couples. 

The Char went live mentioned she already confessed her feelings to E. Said E feels the same way but rn things may be hard with the timing.

E goes lives and say maybe in 3-4 years they can be gfs but people can’t expect them to be married already it’s only been 1 year. Nadek and Yaya only admitted after years of hiding their relationship.

Things start to get shakey with EL and the girls have a week or so off from work. Char travels with Aoom to a beach. 

Char post a video of her and Aoom laying in the bed.

Engfa likes a video of it then unlikes. Engfa then goes to Chompu live and apologies for all the hate and got and not helping her. 

A fan said that Char got into an accident. Engfa said “what accident? She’s in the bed with Aoom.”

Char also went back and posted an hour or two later showing she was also in the bed with Ice seeing the controversy. 

Engfa makes a long tweet. Char replied to said tweet letting her know if you need someone im here. Engfa replied “go to sleep”.

Char then went and deleted all her responses and some tweets she made on her account. 

Engfa posted “reckless” by madison beer. 

Char then went live later that night and ended up crying. 

Char ended up unfollwing Eng some thought it was a glitch lmao then followed unfollowed. Her account got locked by twitter and when it came back she deleted basically all of her tweets from May to July (which was some of the best tweets cause it was their publicly in love era) when it came back she was basically following no one she even unfollwed on tiktok but refollowed. Fans was still debating what was happening with the follow but then Engfa unfollwed too. 

Manila concert. Engfa said with love comes sacrifice and that’s when you know you love someone so much you want to see them do good. Engfa said it’s 100% chance they can date but it’ll need time adjustments to be made. Char was emotional because she didn’t know how eng would feel about it their chances. She was very openly in love.

August 2023
 
 N admitted he sat them down and basically said all they worked for would be destroyed if they dated and basically threatened their careers. 

The rest was history they never re-follwed but still somehow always commenting on eachother’s twitter. 

But the second half of 2024 up until now the girls have been really healthy and happy. 2023 they were new in the industry falling for each other publicly with many people against them. It was hard for them. 

So jealousy and love get you here.

data.raw_text:
Hindi films, The City of Gold and arriving from the hinterland 

40 years to the day since I started working. 
First visit to Bombay, as it was then, at age 21.

Like the quintessential Hindi film protagonist of the 70s and 80's, got off at VT with two suitcases 😄 straight from the Cow belt.

Although I did not come from generational wealth - my grandparents did not own any mansions, least of all, in Bombay but my education and the job gave me a cushion that most new arrivals to the city don't have.

From there to this magnificent view has been quite a journey in what became my karmabhoomi.

Many memories come flooding back from the early years 😊

My friend and batchmate from IIMA was there at VT station to receive and tell me, "You are in my city and I will take care of you" -which he did with unbelievable effort and devotion. 

From showing me the sunset from the Sun & Sand (till then met only in film magazines 😉) coffee shop and the line of magnificent buildings from the Jahangir Art gallery terrace (it cuts out the clutter at the ground level) to taking me to doctors and seeing me off at the airport when I left for the Citibank training course in Manila, he and his family were there for me during my first few years. Ended up tying a rakhi to him - something that has continued through the years.

My father's friend from college Inderjit uncle was in loco parentis... Although much to the amusement of my colleagues I myself became a local guardian to a friend's sister who was only 4 year younger.

Citibank provided chummery (shared bachelor) accommodation. Over 5 years shared flats with I think 14 guys and one girl - some of whom have remained friends till date 

Union Park which was my first home, was a sleepy place back then with no restaurants or lounges in sight!
If the cook was away, one had to go to Hill Road or if one was feeling rich to the revolving restaurant on top of Sea Rock.

After 2 years could say goodbye to local trains with a move to Colaba.

While I am grateful that the city has been incredibly kind to me, I cannot forget that it is a very tough city for most people living here. It took a long time to adjust to the masses of grim-faced people that one saw everyday. Even till date 8 to 10 people die in local trains or the tracks every single day. 

Those are the tough realities.

Also a rude shock was the lack of enough book shops. I was used to the book shops of Lucknow and Delhi and in my mind the construct was that a bigger city meant more and bigger book shops. Bombay simply did not measure up.

On the plus side, I was an early convert to the pleasures of seafood even though I had grown up in a place very far from the sea.

Also, it was clearly a safer place for young women than North India. From police stations to public parks you simply did not face the kind of uncomfortable gaze that was the norm in Delhi, for instance.

Fortunate to have a great  trajectory in the city. Blessings of parents and gurus 🙏🏼🙏🏼
